GPTR-F-001-S111.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S111.description: Implement the core validation engine that evaluates incoming GPTReader requests against the defined allowlist schema and configuration, rejecting any disallowed collections, fields, operators, or query structures before execution.

GPTR-F-001-S112.title: Azure Function Request Interceptor Integration
GPTR-F-001-S112.description: Integrate the allowlist enforcement engine into the Azure Function entry point for GPTReader so that all incoming requests are intercepted and validated prior to any database interaction.

GPTR-F-001-S113.title: Unit and Security Test Coverage for Allowlist Enforcement
GPTR-F-001-S113.description: Develop comprehensive unit tests covering valid and invalid request scenarios, including injection attempts, unauthorized fields, excessive limits, and malformed queries to verify strict enforcement behavior.

GPTR-F-001-S114.title: End-to-End Integration Tests with Enforcement Enabled
GPTR-F-001-S114.description: Extend existing GPTReader integration tests to validate full request lifecycle with enforcement enabled, ensuring compliant queries succeed and non-compliant queries are blocked with correct error responses.
